about: Inkling 2 Mini (Thinking Machines' own checkpoint) on mlx-vlm from Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm@434a1be, the first commit with the Inkling tool-call parser (#2783). Before it, tool calls come back null. Window is 131,072 tokens, one request at a time, bf16 KV (lossless), text only. The wrapper's --text-only drops the 0.64 GB vision tower after loading and rejects image input. Prefill runs in 64-token steps. Inkling's attention materializes a 24-head relative-position bias of prefill-step x context per layer. At mlx-vlm's default 2,048, a 53K prompt ran out of Metal memory on 32 GB. A 128K prompt still did at step 64 with the vision tower loaded, failing on its last token. MLX_VLM_TOKEN_QUEUE_TIMEOUT is raised because a full-window prompt takes ~21 min to read. M2 Max 32 GB (30-core GPU): 127,930-token needle found on a freshly started server, 105 tok/s prefill, 26.31 GB peak against the 26.8 GB default working set (close the big apps), no swap growth. Right after a 92K-token prompt the same server ran out of memory at 100,608 tokens, so restart it before a full-window prompt; ~18 tok/s decode. About 18.9 GB of weights in memory.
install: python3 -m pip install git+https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm.git@434a1bedd1e8a9ec9588462e112e6a0e58696872 mlx==0.32.4 transformers==5.23.0 tokenizers==0.23.3 huggingface_hub==2.4.0 (macOS on Apple silicon, Python >= 3.10)
